|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Temporal Chains''' is a [[spell]] that [[curse]]s all targets in an area, reducing their [[action speed]] and making all [[temporary effect]]s on them [[expire]] more slowly. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Action speed''': Temporal Chains reduces the [[action speed]] of the target. :'''Action speed cap''': The {{c|mod|#% less Action Speed}} modifier is capped at 75%.{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1514557|title=2.1.0c Hotfix|author=Community_Team|date=December 15, 2015|accessdate=May 22, 2021|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums}} This is a local cap, meaning that it only applies to Temporal Chains and has no effect on other [[action speed]] modifiers. '''Slower expiration rate of effects''': Temporal Chains causes duration effects to [[expire]] more slowly, including [[debuffs]] and [[Brand]]s, but not the duration of the curse itself. For the formula, see [[expiration rate]]. At the default 25% slower expiry, effects last 33% longer. At the maximum 75% slower expiry, effects last 300% longer. :'''Slower expiry rate cap''': The slower expiry effect is capped at 75%{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2240771/page/3|title=Temporal chains and 75% limitation question|author=Mark_GGG|date=October 29, 2018|accessdate=May 22, 2021|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums}}; the gem's advanced description specifies ''{{c|help|(Effects cannot be slowed below 25% of their normal expiry rate)}}''. This is a global cap, meaning all sources of [[Expiration rate|expiration rate]] are subject to this limitation. * The slower expiry is affected by modifiers that modify curse effect. * [[Debuff]]s that inflict [[damage over time]] will expire more slowly. This does not cause damage over time effects to deal less DPS; instead, it effectively acts as a multiplier for the duration of the effect. However, it does not actually modify the duration itself. Instead, in-game time passes more slowly for those effects compared to real time, causing their duration timer to also count down more slowly. ** Specifically for [[poison]], although this does not increase the damage per second of a single stack of poison, it does increase the number of poison stacks that can effectively be on a target at one time (as the rate of application is unaffected, but expiration rate is slowed). Due to a lack of a cap for poison stacks, this consequentially increases the overall DPS including all poison stacks at the point where a poison stack would normally wear off. * Recovery effects from [[leech]] and [[flask]] expire more slowly while recovering the same amount per second of whatever resource they provide. However, other sources of life recovery over a fixed time such as {{il|Lifesprig}}, {{il|Doppelgänger Guise}}, and [[recoup]], are unaffected either by the duration of the recovery or the total recovery. '''Area of effect''' According to last announced value in [[version 2.0.0]] patch notes, the base radius of level 1 Temporal Chains skill is 2.2 metres. A level 20 skill will +1 metre to radius. '''Self-curse''': {{main|Self-curse}} Characters can curse themselves with Temporal Chains using {{il|Shackles of the Wretched}} or {{il|Rotblood Promise}} to extend duration buffs such as {{il|Immortal Call}}, or {{il|Boneshatter}} or {{il|Headhunter}} buff stacks. Due to the inherent 50% less effect of curses on [[player]]s, the default Temporal Chains gem will only provide 12.5% slower expiry (effects last 14% longer). To reach the 75% slower expiry cap (effects last 300% longer), the player needs a total of 500% increased curse effect (or 520% with Rotblood Promise). :While {{il|Solstice Vigil}}'s {{stl|Shaper's Presence}} buff is active, the player needs 340% increased curse effect (or 360% with Rotblood Promise). {{il|Runegraft of the Warp}} grants {{c|mod|Buffs on you expire 30% slower}}, reducing the amount of increased curse effect required to reach the cap to 260% (or just 100% with Shaper's Presence). Temporal Chains' downside (reduced [[action speed]]) can be countered with increased action speed stats, or completely negated by {{c|mod|Action Speed cannot be modified to below base value}} (e.g. {{il|Kaom's Roots}}, [[Juggernaut]]'s {{psl|Unstoppable}}, or an {{il|Animate Guardian}} with {{il|Garb of the Ephemeral}}) or {{c|mod|Your Action Speed is at least #% of base value}} (e.g. Trickster's {{psl|One Step Ahead}}, [[Scourge modifier]]s). Radius |c3_header = +x metres to radius |c3_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c3_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" |level=1 |stat=1 |large=1 }} ==Related modifiers== The following mods are related to Temporal Chains: {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain = 1 AND mods.generation_type NOT IN ("10" , "24", "25") |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} ===Legacy mods=== The following mods can only be find in [[legacy item]] in permanent leagues, or just spawn disabled: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain = 1 |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} In addition, since Scourge mechanic is not added to the core game, both the downside and upside Scourge mods are legacy mods: :{{ml|HellscapeUpsideCurseOnHitTemporalChains1|display=stat_text}} (spawned on gloves) :{{ml|HellscapeDownsideCursedWithTemporalChains1|display=stat_text}} (spawned on gloves) {{Skill enchantment modifier list|skill=Temporal Chains}} Note that the {{c|enchanted|#% increased Temporal Chains Curse Effect}} enchantments have legacy mod values (15% and 30%). ==Temporal Chains in maps== {{see also|List of map suffix mods}} Temporal Chains is one of the [[hex]] [[curse]] [[debuff]]s that can be rolled on [[maps]], [[vaal side area]] (in spawn weight table known as "secret_area"), Eldritch and [[Maven's Invitation]]s' arenas (known as "primordial_map" and "maven_map" respectively in spawn weight table) and expedition logbook areas. They all belongs to the same [[mod domain]] no.5. The debuff affects the entire area and cannot be removed, as it would applied back immediately. The character can avoid the curse by having [[curse immunity]] or the {{c|mod|Unaffected by Curses}} mod. The base magnitude of the curse debuff is fixed (same as from level 1 skill) : {{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain = "5" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 }} The following mods can only be find in [[legacy item|legacy]] map in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain = 5 |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} *Delve area mods: {{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain = "17" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 }} *Heist and grand heist mods: {{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain = "22" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 }} *Synthesis area mods {{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain IN ( "18", "19" ) |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 }} In addition, monster with the following explicit, implicit and unique mod would use this curse. Note that some of these mods are legacy mods: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%temporal_chains%" AND domain = "3" OR mods.name LIKE "%Hexfont%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} Notable monster included: * [[Wailing Widow]] ([[The Cathedral Rooftop (Act 5)]] or area with Kitava monsters) ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. * Many Skill Gems now display their radius in metres in the Gem description. ** This does not include Temporal Chains. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.22.1| * Weapon Range displayed on Melee Weapons and other descriptions that use ranges with values now instead use metres. The reminder text for "Close Range" and the description of Presence range in the Character panel also now use metres. }} {{Version history table row|3.22.0| * The Temporal Chains skill gem now has "Other effects on Cursed enemies expire 25% slower" at all gem levels (previously 40%). * The Temporal Chains skill used by Monsters also now causes other effects on Cursed enemies to expire 25% slower (previously 40%). }} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| *Now has {{c|mod|Base duration is ('''5-8''') seconds}} (previously (5-5.95) seconds). *Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed Normal and Magic Enemies have ('''15-29''')% less Action Speed}} (previously (20-29)%). *Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed Rare and Unique Enemies have ('''9-18''')% less Action Speed}} (previously (10-14)%). *Quality no longer grants {{c|mod|(0-10)% increased Effect of Curse}}. Instead, it grants {{c|mod|(0-20)% increased Curse Duration}}. *Anomalous quality no longer grants {{c|mod|Curse has (0-40)% increased Doom gain rate}}. Instead, it now grants {{c|mod|(0-20)% increased Area of Effect}}. *Fixed a bug introduced in 3.12 where applying Temporal Chains in a way not from a Curse Skill, such as through Curse on Hit modifiers, was incorrectly applying Temporal Chains' {{c|mod|50% less effect on Players}} to all targets. * Labyrinth Helmet Enchantments that provide increased Effect to a specific Hex now have values of 10% for the Merciless Enchantments (previously 20%), and 15% for the Eternal Enchantments (previously 30%). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| ''All curse skills have been reworked and are now divided into two categories: Hexes and Marks.'' * Hexes apply a curse in an area and, when manually cast, apply an amount of Doom per second to cursed enemies up to a maximum. Doom increases the effect of the afflicted curse and stacks additively with modifiers to increased Curse effect. * Items which apply a Curse to an enemy (such as the curse-on-hit Ring modifiers) no longer specify a level, and instead have a set magnitude for their values with a fixed amount of Doom, which is overwritten when another source applies a more potent version (similar to Arcane Surge). * Curses applied by casting Temporal Chains now gain 10 Doom per second. *Now gains additional radius as the gem levels, up to +10 at gem level 20 (from +7). * Now gains 1% increased effect of Curse per 2% gem quality (previously caused normal and magic enemies to have 1% less action speed per 2% gem quality). * Now offered [[Witch]], [[Shadow]] and [[Scion]] for completing {{ql|Lost in Love}}, and can be purchased from [[Clarissa]] by the [[Ranger]]. * Now has alternative gem quality. }} {{Version history table row|3.10.0| * Now has 50% less effect against players. Previously, it had 40% reduced effect against players. Note that this change means it is multiplicative with sources of increased curse effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 16 (was 24). * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 33 (was 50). * Now causes Normal and Magic enemies to have 20% less Action Speed at gem level 1, up to 29% less Action Speed at gem level 20. * Now causes Rare and Unique enemies to have 10% less Action Speed at gem level 1, up to 14% less Action Speed at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * The total amount that you can slow the expiration of an effect on a character through a time-slowing mechanism (such as Temporal Chains) is now capped at 75% from all sources. }} {{Version history table row|3.3.0| * Added new corrupted implicits which can appear on items corrupted by {{il|Vaal Orb|Vaal Orbs}}, bringing the total to approximately 176. Many of the old implicits were buffed or moved to different items, and some were disabled. Generally, corrupted implicits are now more powerful on average. * Temporal Chains Skill granted from boots corrupted implicit, is spawn disabled. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Increased Area of Effect mod and its progression per level doubled. }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0c| * Temporal Chains, Enfeeble, Curse on Hit and Blasphemy have had their quality bonuses returned to normal. * A cap of 75% now applies to the action speed reduction caused by Temporal Chains. }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0c| * Temporal Chains quality now grants 0.5% increased Cast Speed per point of quality instead of slowing enemies by 0.5% per point of quality. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.2| * Temporal Chains' slowing effect now applies multiplicatively with [[Chill]]'s slowing effect. This will result in less of an impact when both are used on the same target. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Mana cost reduced at all levels. Area of effect increases per gem level reduced, but the base area of effect has been increased by 37.5% (from 16 to 22). Duration increases per level slightly modified. The end result is slightly longer duration at level 1 but slightly shorter duration at level 20. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * Fixed a bug where chilling monsters or cursing them with Temporal Chains could
